capabilities: Sync vault files two-way with a Seafile library or a folder inside it
Merge concurrent edits of notes and Excalidraw drawings, keeping conflict copies
Compare and restore file versions from the server history
Restore deleted files from the Seafile trash
Limit synced folders and file types per device
extras: iOS/iPadOS support is untested on a device. The README warns against running it alongside another sync for the same vault (Obsidian Sync, Remotely Save, an auto-pushing Git plugin or the Seafile desktop client). Syncing other plugins' settings is off by default.
problem: Vaults kept on a self-hosted Seafile server have no Obsidian-native client, and ordinary file sync can silently overwrite edits made on two devices.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault through your own Seafile server
Excalidraw drawings (.excalidraw.md and .excalidraw) get a merge of their own

summary: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a Seafile library, with three-way merge, conflict copies and deletion safety.
